title: 大盘低开扩散，重庆路桥获初步确认；赣锋与紫金承压 + 美股盘前：Anthropic回落拖累纳指期货1.63%，芯片与云算力链承压
summary: 截至09:56 CST，上证、深证和恒指分别约跌1.72%、2.64%和1.65%，风险偏好较首发进一步走弱。重庆路桥涨6.96%至4.15元，第二大股东增持计划获得初步价格确认，但需防冲高回落；赣锋锂业跌2.95%至33.19元，回购与固态电池线索未获确认；紫金矿业跌4.40%至22.83元，金属链负面反馈与回避结论强化。08:35首发截止后未发现改变判断的新增重大政策或公告。 截至05:37 ET，道指、标普500与纳指100期货分别下跌0.20%、0.76%和1.63%。Anthropic上市次日盘前回落6.8%，NVDA跌2.6%，AMD、AVGO、MRVL与MU跌3.5%至5.5%；VIX一度升至30.04。GAP受Old Navy销售好于预期支持涨2.5%，BSP业绩超预期并上调收入展望后小幅上涨。

2
板块对照
截至08:23 CST延时报价：GRABW +50.00%、KG +11.14%，确认应用软件与再保险代表股延续；PANW +6.38%、MVST +6.56%，确认网络安全与固态电池代表股延续。ACON +7.46%、SEGG +18.49%、GDC +9.65%与其所属下跌行业构成内部背离；CROX -3.35%、SVM -4.73%确认鞋类与白银弱势。 来源
3
A/H 映射
截至09:56，上证、深证和恒指分别跌1.72%、2.64%和1.65%，开盘承接偏弱。重庆路桥涨6.96%获得初步确认但不宜追高；赣锋跌2.95%、紫金跌4.40%，负面反馈下均维持回避。 来源

增量复核结论

事实：截至09:56延时行情，上证、深证和恒指分别跌1.72%、2.64%和1.65%；赣锋锂业跌2.95%、紫金矿业跌4.40%，重庆路桥涨6.96%。

判断：整体风险偏好进一步走弱。重庆路桥对增持计划形成初步价格确认，但需防冲高回落；赣锋回购与固态电池线索未获确认，紫金回避结论强化。

不确定性：价格为09:56云端延时快照；08:35首发截止后未发现会改变判断的新增重大政策或公告，后续仍需观察午盘量价与增持/回购执行。

重点个股关注

赣锋锂业
002460.SZ
回避
事实与状态：披露A股回购报告书；截至09:56延时行情报33.19元、跌2.95%，明显弱于公告前收盘，回购与固态电池线索未获价格确认。
重新评估条件：股价止跌并重新跑赢锂电板块，成交量改善，且回购实际执行或固态电池业务进展提供后续证据。
风险与失效条件：公告后已出现负面价格反馈；若持续弱于锂电板块、回购执行迟缓或锂价继续下行，维持回避。
重庆路桥
600106.SH
初步确认
事实与状态：第二大股东披露增持计划；截至09:56延时行情报4.15元、涨6.96%，公告后获得明显正向价格与成交反馈。
后续验证：观察涨幅能否在午盘前保持、成交量能否延续，并等待增持进度、资金来源与执行规模的后续公告。
风险与失效条件：若快速冲高回落、量价背离或增持执行不及计划，正向确认失效，避免追高。
紫金矿业
601899.SH
回避
事实与状态：拟以不超过35元/股回购A股；截至09:56延时行情报22.83元、跌4.40%，叠加隔夜白银行业跌5.79%，负面价格反馈进一步强化。
重新评估条件：金属价格止跌、公司重新跑赢资源板块，并由回购实际成交形成可核验支撑。
风险与失效条件：若银、金、铜链继续承压或股价延续弱势，维持回避；回购标题不能覆盖商品风险。

板块轮动看板

受益方向

农业机器人场景、5G+工业互联网城市试点、网络安全与固态电池相对强势线索。

观察方向

重庆路桥增持获初步量价确认但需防冲高回落；赣锋回购未获确认，纳芯微并购仍需验证整合与审批。

压力方向

美股约2%级别下跌、A股市场宽度偏弱，电子游戏、白银及资源链承压。

验证信号

午盘前市场宽度、重庆路桥涨幅与成交延续性、赣锋和紫金能否止跌，以及10年期美债收益率能否稳定。

逻辑链

美股与ETF代理同步大跌 → 风险偏好收缩 → A/H高估值科技先看承接，不把相对强势榜直接翻译为买入。
农业机器人与工业互联网政策 → 应用场景扩容 → 只有订单、预算或公告后价格验证才形成公司级催化。
固态电池概念小幅上涨 + 赣锋回购 → 赣锋开盘后跌2.95% → 事件线索未获价格确认，降为回避。
白银行业大跌 + 紫金股价下跌 → 回购催化被负面价格反馈覆盖 → 明确回避而非包装多头。

风险雷达

美股连续下跌且道指单日跌1,101点，全球风险偏好可能继续传导至A/H。
应用软件虽涨3.61%，但24涨201跌，标题涨幅与内部宽度明显背离。
白银、电子游戏与多媒体位居行业跌幅末端，资源与成长风险同时存在。
回购、增持和并购均有执行、审批或整合风险，公告本身不是收益承诺。
恒指09:56延时行情跌1.65%，与A股共同反映风险偏好偏弱；延时数据仍需午盘继续核验。

数据来源与时间点

来源：国内发现源为巨潮资讯公告检索、港交所公告检索与上交所公告索引，实际检索截至2026-11-20 08:35 CST；原始源为工信部、商务部、港交所/巨潮公告。国际与隔夜行情源为AP、Reuters、GitHub Actions Moomoo快照及AKShare v2；09:56 A/H价格反馈来自东方财富云端延时接口。增量复核时间：2026-11-20 09:56 CST。

Wall Street posts its longest losing streak since 2024

MIIT opens applications for 2026 5G + Industrial Internet city pilots

Cybersecurity rose 1.25% with PANW +6.42%, and solid-state batteries gained 0.31% with MVST +5.73%; A/H software-security and lithium mappings still require open-price confirmation. Source

Ganfeng Lithium publishes an A-share buyback plan
The company filed its buyback report on Nov. 19; the latest verified close was about RMB34.18. The solid-state-battery concept rose only 0.31%, and no post-announcement A-share reaction exists yet. Source

Chongqing Road & Bridge's second-largest shareholder plans to add shares
The plan was disclosed after the Nov. 19 close. The stock ended at RMB3.88, up 1.84%, but that move preceded public disclosure and cannot count as post-announcement confirmation. Source

Zijin buyback is outweighed by metals weakness
The company proposes an A-share buyback capped at RMB35 per share. The stock fell 2.61% to RMB23.88 and the U.S. silver industry lost 5.79%, so negative feedback remains dominant. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

1
Overnight index proxies
The Dow lost 1,101 points and the Nasdaq 550.69. At 08:18 CST, delayed DIA, SPY and QQQ proxies were down about 2.18%, 1.97% and 2.14%, respectively. Source
2
Sector cross-check
At 08:23 CST on delayed quotes: GRABW +50.00% and KG +11.14% confirmed their leading industry signals; PANW +6.38% and MVST +6.56% confirmed cybersecurity and solid-state-battery strength. ACON +7.46%, SEGG +18.49% and GDC +9.65% diverged from their weak groups, while CROX -3.35% and SVM -4.73% confirmed footwear and silver weakness. Source
3
A/H mapping
At 09:56, the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component and Hang Seng were down 1.72%, 2.64% and 1.65%, showing weak post-open breadth. Chongqing Road & Bridge gained 6.96% for initial confirmation but should not be chased; Ganfeng fell 2.95% and Zijin 4.40%, keeping both in avoid. Source

Incremental Review

Facts: at 09:56 on delayed quotes, the Shanghai Composite, Shenzhen Component and Hang Seng were down 1.72%, 2.64% and 1.65%; Ganfeng fell 2.95%, Zijin 4.40%, while Chongqing Road & Bridge gained 6.96%.

View: broad risk appetite weakened further. Chongqing Road & Bridge has initial confirmation but faces fade risk; Ganfeng’s buyback and solid-state-battery signals lack confirmation, while Zijin’s avoid case strengthened.

Uncertainty: prices are 09:56 cloud-delayed snapshots. No new material policy or filing after the 08:35 first-run cutoff changed the thesis; midday price-volume behavior and buyback/accumulation execution still need monitoring.

Stocks to Watch

Ganfeng Lithium
002460.SZ
Avoid
Facts and status: the A-share buyback report is filed. At 09:56 on delayed quotes, the stock was RMB33.19, down 2.95% and well below its pre-filing close; the buyback and solid-state-battery signals lack price confirmation.
Reassessment: the stock stabilizes and regains relative strength versus lithium peers, volume improves, and actual buyback execution or solid-state-battery progress provides follow-through evidence.
Risk: negative post-filing price feedback is already visible. Continued underperformance, slow buyback execution or further lithium-price pressure keeps the stock in avoid.
Chongqing Road & Bridge
600106.SH
Initial confirmation
Facts and status: the second-largest shareholder disclosed an accumulation plan. At 09:56 on delayed quotes, the stock was RMB4.15, up 6.96%, providing clear post-disclosure price and volume confirmation.
Follow-through: watch whether the gain and volume persist into midday, and verify later filings on funding, purchase pace and execution size.
Risk: a rapid fade, price-volume divergence or execution below plan invalidates the initial confirmation; avoid chasing the opening move.
Zijin Mining
601899.SH
Avoid
Facts and status: an A-share buyback capped at RMB35 is proposed. At 09:56 on delayed quotes, the stock was RMB22.83, down 4.40%; combined with the U.S. silver industry’s 5.79% loss, negative feedback strengthened.
Reassessment: metals stabilize, Zijin starts outperforming the resource complex, and actual buyback trades provide verifiable support.
Invalidation: continued weakness in silver, gold or copper, or further relative underperformance, keeps the avoid status. The buyback headline does not erase commodity risk.

Sector Rotation

Potential beneficiaries

Agricultural robotics, 5G + Industrial Internet pilots, cybersecurity and solid-state-battery signals.

Watch

Chongqing Road & Bridge has initial price-volume confirmation but faces fade risk; Ganfeng lacks confirmation, while NOVOSENSE still needs approval and integration evidence.

Pressure

A roughly 2% US selloff, weak A-share breadth, and sharp losses in gaming, silver and resource exposures.

Validation

Breadth into midday, persistence in Chongqing Road & Bridge, stabilization in Ganfeng and Zijin, and the 10-year Treasury yield.

Logic Chain

US equities and ETF proxies sell off together → risk appetite contracts → A/H growth must prove support before any upgrade.
Robotics and industrial-internet policies → deployment scenarios expand → orders, budgets or post-announcement prices are still required.
Solid-state batteries edge higher + Ganfeng buyback → Ganfeng falls 2.95% after the open → the event signal lacks price confirmation and moves to avoid.
Silver industry falls + Zijin drops → buyback catalyst is outweighed by negative feedback → avoid rather than package a bullish call.

Risk Radar

The Dow's 1,101-point drop can transmit global risk aversion into A/H.
Application software rose 3.61% despite only 24 advancers versus 201 decliners, a severe headline-breadth divergence.
Gaming, silver and resource exposures rank near the bottom, combining growth and commodity risk.
Buybacks, accumulation and M&A carry execution, approval and integration risks; filings are not return guarantees.
The Hang Seng was down 1.65% on a 09:56 delayed quote, confirming weak cross-market risk appetite; delayed data still require a midday recheck.

Sources and Timestamp

Sources: domestic discovery used CNInfo, HKEX and SSE announcement indexes through 08:35 CST; primary sources include MIIT, MOFCOM and exchange filings. International and overnight inputs used AP, Reuters, the GitHub Actions Moomoo snapshot and AKShare v2. The 09:56 A/H price feedback came from Eastmoney’s cloud-delayed endpoint. Incremental review: 2026-11-20 09:56 CST.

盘前结论

事实：科技权重与AI基础设施盘前普跌，纳指100期货明显弱于道指期货，VIX触及30.04；油价与10年期美债收益率回落仅提供有限缓冲。

判断：基准情景是科技主导的低开，首小时观察卖压是否扩散至金融、工业与小盘股。若VIX回落、纳指期货收复至少一半跌幅，可出现超跌反抽；否则反弹更可能是减仓窗口。

不确定性：月度期权到期、联储官员讲话与密歇根数据可能改变波动路径，个股应以价格反馈而非利好叙事为准。

重点个股推荐

Gap
GAP
正反馈

推荐理由：Old Navy销售好于预期，盘前涨2.5%，在大盘与可选消费承压时体现相对强势。

触发因素：开盘后守住财报跳空区并保持板块内相对强势。

风险点：全年指引下调、节日需求与促销压力可能限制持续性。

Bending Spoons
BSP
业绩上修

推荐理由：调整后EPS 0.42美元高于约0.32美元预期，收入7.80亿美元亦超预期，全年收入指引上调后盘前小幅上涨。

触发因素：股价守住发行后支撑并在电话会后扩大正反馈。

风险点：有机增长仅约3%、净债务40亿美元及并购整合负担。

Keysight Technologies
KEYS
相对抗跌

推荐理由：EPS 3.61美元与收入19.9亿美元均高于预期；盘前跌约0.8%，明显好于纳指期货1.63%的跌幅。

触发因素：开盘后转正且半导体设备或测试链同步企稳。

风险点：当前仍是负涨幅，若AI硬件抛压扩散应降级观察。

板块轮动看板

强势观察

零售个股与软件并购链：GAP、BSP有正反馈，但仅适合确认后参与。

事件驱动

月度期权到期、密歇根情绪与联储官员讲话可能放大盘中切换。

压力方向

芯片、云算力、数据中心与高估值软件；避免在首轮急跌中盲目抄底。

验证信号

纳指期货收复早盘跌幅、VIX回落至28下方、10年债不再上行。

逻辑链

Anthropic次日回落6.8%，AI信心修复失败
芯片、云算力与数据中心同步下挫，卖压扩散
纳指期货跌1.63%、VIX触及30，风险预算收缩
高估值科技开盘偏弱，资金转向防御与财报正反馈

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司。已检查 StockMarketAgent、StreetIdea 与 The Right Trader 的11月20日财报日历；仅发现DLNG被列为盘后披露，属于航运基础设施而非科技公司，其余多为盘前或时间未定。由于缺少同时具备一致预期、历史surprise、近期指引与卖方修正的待披露科技样本，本期不虚构高/中/低概率。

行业判断：科技板块核心变量转为已披露财报后的价格反馈、AI资本开支回报与利率；INTU盈利超预期仍遭双位数下跌，说明估值和指引权重高于单季beat。

风险雷达

AI交易去杠杆继续，可能触发芯片与云算力二次下探。

VIX高位叠加月度期权到期，开盘后波动与假突破风险上升。

12月加息定价过高，鹰派讲话或通胀线索可能推升实际利率。

Brent回落缓解成本压力，但霍尔木兹与中东消息仍可能快速逆转油价。

GAP、BSP与KEYS的相对强势若在放量后消失，应立即降级为观察。

来源与时间：Reuters（05:37 ET期指与盘前个股）、LSEG/CME FedWatch、公司公告（INTU、ROST、BSP）、Cboe VIX、StockAnalysis及公开财报日历；生成时间 2026-11-20 20:31 CST。盘前价格可能快速变化，部分个股量能未完整披露。

CRWV and NBIS fall more than 5%, while IREN, APLD and CORZ lose 2.8%-4% as capex-return concerns intensify.
Macro
Tech leads futures lower
Around 05:37 ET, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures fall 0.20%, 0.76% and 1.63%, signaling a defensive tilt.
Macro
VIX touches 30.04
The volatility index reaches a seven-month high; monthly options expiry may amplify two-way moves after the open.
Macro
Fed tone stays hawkish
Philadelphia Fed President Paulson says inflation remains too high and another hike is needed; markets price a 98.4% December-hike probability.
Macro
Oil prices retreat
Brent falls 1.6% as markets focus on surplus supply and normalized Strait of Hormuz flows, marginally easing energy-cost pressure.
Earnings
GAP gets positive feedback
GAP rises 2.5% premarket after Old Navy sales beat expectations; a lower full-year outlook still argues against chasing.
Earnings
Post-earnings feedback diverges
INTU falls about 11.4% despite a beat and ROST loses about 3.4%; BSP edges higher after raising guidance, while KEYS declines less than Nasdaq futures.

Premarket Takeaway

Facts: Tech leaders and AI infrastructure are broadly lower, Nasdaq 100 futures underperform Dow futures, and VIX touches 30.04; lower oil and the 10-year yield provide limited relief.

View: The base case is a tech-led gap lower. Watch whether selling spreads from AI into financials, industrials and small caps. A VIX retreat and recovery of half the Nasdaq-futures loss could trigger an oversold bounce; otherwise rallies are de-risking windows.

Uncertainty: Options expiry, Fed speakers and Michigan data may reshape volatility; follow price feedback rather than favorable narratives.

Stock Focus

Gap
GAP
Positive

Rationale: Better-than-expected Old Navy sales lift the stock 2.5% premarket, showing relative strength while the market weakens.

Trigger: The earnings gap holds after the open and retail-relative strength persists.

Risk: Lower full-year guidance, holiday demand and promotions may cap follow-through.

Bending Spoons
BSP
Beat and raise

Rationale: Adjusted EPS of $0.42 beats roughly $0.32 expected, $780 million revenue tops estimates, and shares edge higher after a guidance increase.

Trigger: The stock holds post-listing support and extends positive feedback after the call.

Risk: Organic growth of only about 3%, $4.0 billion net debt and integration burden.

Keysight Technologies
KEYS
Relative resilience

Rationale: EPS of $3.61 and $1.99 billion revenue both beat estimates; a roughly 0.8% decline is materially better than Nasdaq futures' 1.63% loss.

Trigger: Shares turn positive as semiconductor equipment or test peers stabilize.

Risk: The move is still negative; downgrade to watch-only if AI-hardware selling broadens.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength watch

Retail-specific and software M&A names: GAP and BSP show positive feedback, but only after confirmation.

Event-driven

Monthly options expiry, Michigan sentiment and Fed speakers may amplify intraday rotations.

Pressure areas

Chips, neoclouds, data centers and high-valuation software; avoid blindly buying the first sharp dip.

Confirmation signals

Nasdaq futures retrace early losses, VIX falls below 28 and the 10-year yield stops rising.

Logic Chain

Anthropic falls 6.8% on day two, ending the attempted AI-confidence rebound
Chips, neoclouds and data centers fall together as selling broadens
Nasdaq futures lose 1.63% and VIX touches 30, shrinking risk budgets
High-valuation tech opens weak as flows rotate toward defense and earnings-specific winners

After-hours Earnings Beat Probability

Insufficient verifiable after-hours tech reporters / no large technology company. StockMarketAgent, StreetIdea and The Right Trader calendars for November 20 were checked. Only DLNG is listed after the close, and it is shipping infrastructure rather than technology; others report before the open or have unconfirmed timing. With no pending tech sample supported by consensus, historical surprises, guidance and revisions, no High/Medium/Low probability is fabricated.

Industry view: Tech's key variables shift to post-report price feedback, AI capex returns and rates. INTU's double-digit decline despite a beat shows valuation and guidance outweighing one-quarter results.

Risk Radar

Further AI-trade deleveraging could trigger a second leg down in chips and cloud infrastructure.

High VIX plus monthly options expiry raises opening volatility and false-breakout risk.

Heavy December-hike pricing leaves real yields sensitive to hawkish remarks or inflation signals.

Lower Brent eases costs, but Hormuz and Middle East headlines could quickly reverse oil.

If relative strength in GAP, BSP or KEYS vanishes on volume, downgrade them to watch-only immediately.
